title: Stubserver-backed Tier 1 E2E tests + fault injection
description:
Implement stubserver-backed E2E tests from docs/plans/17-external-testing.md Section 12.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Depends on: T1 (NewHandler + fixtures must exist)

Key deliverables:
- Stubserver-backed Tier 1 tests in e2etests/external/tier1/: full agent loop with real Anthropic provider pointed at in-process stubserver via base URL override
- Multi-turn scenario test (tool call + response over real HTTP/SSE)
- Auth header propagation verification
- Fault injection variants: TCP reset (F1), malformed SSE (F2), rate limiting/429 (F3), backpressure/timeout (F4), empty body (F6), retry sequences
- Update make test-external-tier1 if needed
- All tests pass with make test-external-tier1

AC: Tier 1 tests exercise full HTTP/SSE stack without Docker, fault injection catches real failure modes, all tests pass.
